            double a2r = (realA[i] + realA[j]) / 2;
            double a2i = (imagA[j] - imagA[i]) / 2;
            double b1r = (realB[i] + realB[j]) / 2;
            double b1i = (imagB[i] - imagB[j]) / 2;
            double b2r = (imagB[i] + imagB[j]) / 2;
            double b2i = (realB[j] - realB[i]) / 2;
            cReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            cImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
            dReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            dImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }
        fftCompute(cReal, cImag, true);
        fftCompute(dReal, dImag, true);
        int[] res = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            long aa = (long) (cReal[i] + 0.5);
            long bb = (long) (dReal[i] + 0.5);
            long cc = (long) (cImag[i] + 0.5);
            res[i] = (int) ((aa + (bb << 15) + (cc << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void fftCompute(double[] a, double[] b, boolean inverse) {
        int n = a.length;
        int j = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            while (j >= bit) {
                j -= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j += bit;
            if (i < j) {
                double tmpA = a[i];
                a[i] = a[j];
                a[j] = tmpA;
                double tmpB = b[i];
                b[i] = b[j];
                b[j] = tmpB;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            double angle = 2 * Math.PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            double wlenA = Math.cos(angle);
            double wlenB = Math.sin(angle);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                double wA = 1, wB = 0;
                for (int j1 = 0; j1 < len / 2; j1++) {
                    int u = i + j1;
                    int v = i + j1 + len / 2;
                    double uA = a[u], uB = b[u];
                    double vA = a[v], vB = b[v];
                    double tA = vA * wA - vB * wB;
                    double tB = vA * wB + vB * wA;
                    a[u] = uA + tA;
                    b[u] = uB + tB;
                    a[v] = uA - tA;
                    b[v] = uB - tB;
                    double nextWA = wA * wlenA - wB * wlenB;
                    double nextWB = wA * wlenB + wB * wlenA;
                    wA = nextWA;
                    wB = nextWB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] /= n;
                b[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
}
